programme.notes: RELATED, not the programme: IP Paris has no bachelor titled Computer Science/Informatics. Its only Bachelor of Science (delivered by École Polytechnique, 3 years, English) leads to one of three double majors; the closest is the joined shape 'Mathematics and Computer Science' -> programme_status unknown per the owner ruling on joined shapes. The answers below are for that Bachelor of Science (admissions are to the Bachelor, not to a major).

english.notes: Cambridge CAE/CPE B - 176 (min 169 per skill). Result less than two years old on entry. Exemption possible for native speakers or two years of English-medium study. Note the page writes '6,5' (decimal comma).

gpa.notes: Prose only: 'have an overall strong academic average', advanced mathematics and at least one advanced science course; holistic selection. No numeric threshold.

deadline.quote: Round 3 January 7, 2027 to February 8, 2027 at 2 PM (CET)
extra_quotes: Round 1 September 17, 2026 to October 20, 2026 at 11:59 PM (CEST)
Round 2 October 21, 2026 to January 6, 2027 at 11:59 PM (CET)
deadline.notes: Three rounds, no quotas by round or nationality; the last round closes 8 February 2027, 2 PM CET. Financial-aid seekers are encouraged to apply in early rounds. The page heading says 'You can find 2026 intakes right below' but the rounds run Sept 2026 - Feb 2027, i.e. entry in autumn 2027. Applying via Parcoursup is the alternative route (one route per year).

tuition.notes: 'ANNUAL TUITION FEES'; EU/EEA €15,900/year. 'Tuition fees remain constant throughout the Program.' No academic year printed on the page; 'Rates are subject to change.'

value.name: Excellence Scholarship (Bachelor of Science, École Polytechnique)

scholarship_exists.quote: The Excellence Scholarship amounts to 4,800 Euros in total per year, for 3 years.
scholarship_exists.notes: Merit-based, only for students admitted with honors; competitive; number depends on funds. PARTIAL (tuition is €19,600). Also: need-based aid, and a Full Scholarship Scheme for International Olympiad medalists (max 87,900 EUR per non-EU/EEA student, tuition waived except the 1,500 EUR annual administration fee).

scholarship_international.notes: The Excellence Scholarship section states no nationality condition, and the page says the school admits students 'from all over the world using a need-blind admissions process', but no sentence says the Excellence Scholarship is open to international students. The Olympiad scheme is explicitly sized per non-EU/EEA student ('Maximum scholarship limit (tuition fees plus living allowance) is 87,900 Euros per non-EU/EEA student') - a different, narrow award.
